trip.hotel: AX ODYCY, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta
trip.event: Thunderpick World Championship 2026 Finals, BLAST Arena Studios, Attard (Ta' Qali), match days 2026-10-14/2026-10-18

items.name: Plugs & power — Type G, 230 V, 50 Hz
items.description: Malta uses the British three-rectangular-pin plug (Type G) at 230 V / 50 Hz. US travellers need a Type G (or universal) adapter; modern chargers are dual-voltage (100–240 V) so shape is the only issue. US-only 110 V gear needs a converter — or leave it home. Sockets often have on/off switches.
items.notes: Electrical Safety First (UK statutory safety body) + travel-adaptor.com + two independent guides — all agree. No Maltese government page states the standard (flag carried from 23 Sep 2026).

items.name: Emergency numbers (112)
items.description: 112 = all emergencies (police/fire/ambulance), works from any phone incl. foreign SIM or no SIM. Emergency SMS 79 770 112. US Embassy Malta +356 2561 4000 (24/7) — Ta' Qali National Park Street, Attard (same complex as the tournament venue).
items.notes: Malta Consumer Affairs (government) + State Department advisory (Level 1, 9 Jul 2026) + EU 112 Emergency. Full helpline list on everyday.html § 2 (179, 116 006, 2568 9700, 1579, 153, 1777, 1772).

items.name: Language — Maltese & English official
items.description: Maltese and English are both official languages; English is used everywhere a visitor needs it — signs, menus, hospitals. No phrasebook needed.

items.name: Money — euro, cards, Amex caution
items.description: Malta uses the euro (since 2008). Cards widely accepted, but per the State Department American Express is NOT widely accepted — carry Visa/Mastercard. ATMs accept US cards but frequently charge a fee. Prices are VAT-inclusive.
items.notes: State Department Malta advisory (9 Jul 2026) + Brittanica (carried). EUR/USD 1.145 close of 22 Sep 2026 (TradingEconomics, as recorded in the dossier's sources).

items.name: VAT 18% standard
items.price_range: 18% standard; 7% accommodation; 5% museums/concerts; 0% most groceries/medicines; 12% narrow band
items.description: Standard VAT is 18% (restaurant meals included). Prices on shelves and menus are VAT-inclusive — no US-style add-on at the till.
items.notes: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries (carried; the Commissioner for Revenue's own page errored at check time — flag).

items.name: Tipping — optional, ~5–10%
items.price_range: Round up or ~5–10% at table service; small change at cafés
items.description: Tipping is not obligatory and there is no US-style expectation. Round up the bill or leave ~5–10% if no service charge is on the bill; check the bill first.
items.notes: Local guidance (r/malta thread + tipping guide) — community-sourced, directionally consistent; carried from 23 Sep 2026.

items.name: Tap water — safe to drink
items.description: Tap water is potable and EU-compliant (Water Services Corporation guarantee; desalinated + groundwater blend). Taste divides locals; filtering is a taste choice, not a safety requirement.
items.notes: The Journal (WSC Q&A) + Yale EPI ranking via TVM News (carried from 23 Sep 2026).

items.name: Weather in your window (13–19 Oct 2026)
items.description: Mid-October: typically ~20–24 °C days, cooler evenings; sea still ~23–24 °C; rain possible but not the norm. Pack a light evening layer + sunscreen; the sea is still swimmable.
items.notes: Climate normals (TUI + Sunheron) — estimates, not a forecast; check a live forecast in the week before travel.

items.name: Healthcare & insurance — not free for visitors
items.description: Medical care is not free to non-contributors; private hospitals often require payment up front; most US plans (incl. Medicare/Medicaid) do not cover you abroad. Buy a policy before you fly.
items.notes: State Department health/insurance section (carried from 23 Sep 2026). The giveaway Terms exclude insurance (Terms §5) — noted for the prize framing; for this trip, arrange your own.

items.name: SIM & eSIM for a week in Malta
items.address: Airport kiosks + operator shops; eSIM before you fly
items.price_range: Local prepaid SIM ≈ €10–16 for a week; eSIM ≈ €4–20 for 1–10 GB/7 days; US carrier day-passes ~$10–12/day
items.description: US travellers are not covered by EU free-roaming: get a local GO / Epic / Melita prepaid SIM at the airport or a town shop, or an eSIM (Airalo/Holafly/Ubigi/Nomad/eSim.sm) activated before you land. 2026 guide bands: GO Smart S €5.99 (1 GB/4 wks), Smart M €11.99 (15 GB), Smart Unlimited €15.99; GO starter packs ~€15 (1 GB + €5 credit); Epic FREE SIM + €10 credit for €10, Data Pack €6.99 (4 GB/28 d), Value Promo €4.99 first 6 purchases then €10.99 (10 GB); Melita Pocket Pass M €10 (2 GB), L €15 (5 GB). eSIM resellers: Airalo from $4.50 (1 GB/7 d), Holafly unlimited from $19 (5 d), Ubigi 10 GB/7 d $9, Nomad 1 GB/7 d $4.50.
items.notes: Operator price bands from roafly (May 2026, quoting operator pages), esimmalta.com and malta-spirit (Jul 2026); eSIM reseller prices from their own sites (Sep 2026). Point-in-time — re-check the operators' official sites (go.com.mt, epic.com.mt, melita.com) before buying. Physical SIM needs passport registration; eSIM needs a compatible phone (dual-SIM keeps your US number live).

items.name: Customs — duty-free allowances (air arrival)
items.price_range: Tobacco: 200 cigarettes OR 100 cigarillos OR 50 cigars OR 250 g tobacco · Alcohol: 1 L spirits >22% (or 2 L liquors ≤22%) + 4 L wine + 16 L beer · Other goods: €430 value (air travellers) · Cash: declare €10,000+
items.description: Arriving from outside the EU you use the green (nothing to declare) or red channel. Allowances are per traveller aged 17+ and cannot be pooled. Tobacco/alcohol allowances do not apply to under-17s. Exceed the limits and declare at the red channel — duties apply to the excess.
items.notes: Malta International Airport's official customs page (read 9 Oct 2026) — allowances verbatim (200/100/50/250 g; 1 L >22% or 1 L ethyl alcohol >80% or 2 L ≤22%; 16 L beer; 4 L wine; under-17 exclusion). The €430 other-goods value limit is the EU air/sea traveller threshold (Regulation 1186/2009 art. 41; EC travellers' allowances framework) — corroborated by 2026 guides; the €10,000 cash declaration per the State Department (already on logistics.html).

items.name: Time zone — CEST (UTC+2), +9 h from California
items.description: Malta is on Central European Summer Time (CEST, UTC+2) for your whole trip — EU daylight saving ends Sun 25 Oct 2026, after you leave. That's 9 hours ahead of San Francisco (PDT): 09:00 in SFO = 18:00 in Malta.
items.notes: State Department advisory (CEST window covers 13–19 Oct 2026) — carried from 23 Sep 2026.

items.name: Cannabis/CBD — illegal for visitors
items.description: Cannabis products including CBD are illegal for visitors; drug penalties are severe. Leave any CBD oil/gummies at home, even if legal in California.
items.notes: State Department Malta advisory (carried from 23 Sep 2026).

items.name: Drones — register with Transport Malta
items.description: Drones must be registered with Transport Malta before flying in Malta.
items.notes: State Department note + Transport Malta registration link (carried from 23 Sep 2026).

items.name: Left-hand driving
items.description: Traffic drives on the left; roads are narrow and congested and driving standards differ from the US (State Department). Most visitors skip the car — see Getting Around.

items.name: Drinking age 17
items.price_range: Venues check ID; clubs may set 18+/21+ door policies
items.description: The legal drinking/purchase age in Malta is 17. The customs allowances for tobacco/alcohol also exclude under-17s.
items.notes: Secondary sources (tripbase 2026 + WorldAtlas; no Maltese government page located) — flag carried. The airport customs page's under-17 exclusion is official (9 Oct 2026).

items.name: US Embassy Malta — +356 2561 4000, Ta' Qali
items.area: Attard (same complex as the tournament venue)
items.address: Ta' Qali National Park Street, Attard ATD 4000
items.description: The US Embassy is at Ta' Qali National Park Street, Attard ATD 4000 — the same Ta' Qali complex as BLAST Arena Studios. Emergency line +356 2561 4000 (24/7).
items.notes: mt.usembassy.gov + State Department advisory (carried from 23 Sep 2026).

items.name: No Maltese public holidays in 13–19 Oct 2026
items.description: No Maltese public holidays fall in your window (nearest are 21 Sep and 8 Dec) — museums and shops run normal weekday/Saturday patterns; St John's Co-Cathedral is closed on Sunday 18 Oct as every Sunday.
items.notes: General-knowledge check carried from 23 Sep 2026; shop opening-hour patterns deliberately not stated (no official 2026 source checked) — flag kept.

items.name: Cash declaration — €10,000+
items.price_range: Declare cash or negotiable instruments of €10,000 or more equivalent
items.description: Declare cash (or equivalent negotiable instruments) of €10,000 or more when entering or leaving the EU. Not applicable if you travel card-light.
items.notes: State Department Malta advisory (carried; also on logistics.html § 1).
